As published on 26 November 2026.

## A dimension bound for algebras generated by commuting operators

[Theorem ALG.1647](https://andrewodesky.com/rh/lean/DiscreteGroups.sglob.LConv.Comm.allP/)

For every pair of integers $\ell,t\ge0$, there exists an integer $c\ge0$ such that the following holds. If $V$ is a finite-dimensional complex vector space and $a_1,\ldots,a_\ell\in\operatorname{End}_{\mathbb C}(V)$ commute pairwise, then, writing $A=\mathbb C[a_1,\ldots,a_\ell]$ and $n=\dim_{\mathbb C}V$, $$t\,\dim_{\mathbb C}A\le n^2+cn.$$
